preconditions.description: The number of groups must be between 1 and 100.
The number of friends in each group must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= friend <= number_of_friends for friend in friends)
preconditions.description: Each friend label must be a valid number within the range of friends in the group.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the most popular friend label and the average distance with six digits of precision.
The most popular friend must be the one with the least notoriety in the group.
The average distance must be calculated as the sum of distances from the most popular friend to all other friends divided by the number of friends.
